content: He who conquers his own restless passions is mightier than he who captures a fortified city.
author: Ancient Greek Proverbs
sourceWork: Classical Gnomic Maxims & Cleobulus of Lindos
explanation: Battering down stone city gates requires catapults and gunpowder; mastering your own vanity, greed, and spite requires supreme spiritual heroism. Many generals who commanded legions died as pathetic slaves to their own tantrums. Conquer the citadel within.
practicalInsight: Notice the exact moment your anger or impulse flares up today. Breathe, hold your ground, and rule your own kingdom.
reflectionPrompt: Are you spending all your energy trying to control other people, while your own emotions run completely undisciplined?
